comparison.objective: Measure subfloor flatness and report PASS/FAIL, versus tune a damper to repeatable stopping behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Set a straightedge, insert/read a wedge at the deepest gap, and place a classification puck; no fastener or iterative adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Wedge reading matches the deepest trough within 0.3 mm and the correct threshold label is selected.
comparison.reason: Both use physical measurements to guide an action, but metrology/classification is not closed-loop mechanism commissioning.
